title: sisyrinchium arenarium subsp. microspathum
intro: Sisyrinchium arenarium subsp. microspathum, commonly known as Blue-eyed Grass, is a perennial plant belonging to the Iridaceae family. The health benefits of Blue-eyed Grass include its potential use in treating inflammation and respiratory issues, with its antiseptic and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant involve its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory problems. Bioactive constituents of Blue-eyed Grass include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
